note.fr: L'admission en L1 est sélective : la commission examine surtout les notes en mathématiques, physique et sciences de l'ingénieur, ainsi que la motivation. Consultez aussi la procédure Etudes en France / DAP.
note.en: Admission to L1 is selective: the commission mainly reviews grades in mathematics, physics and engineering sciences, plus motivation. Also check the Etudes en France / DAP procedure.

notes: No tuition fact: the only fee figure (178 euros, Parcoursup fiche) is for French/EU students and for boursiers; the Campus France Morocco page's differentiated fees (2 902 euros for a Licence) are an institution-wide/general figure, not stated for this programme. No intakes fact: the dated calendar (definitive deadline 15 December 2025) is on the university's DAP L1 page, which is a procedure page, and the Parcoursup dates are for French/EU Bac holders, not for a Moroccan-Bac non-EU applicant. teachingLanguages: the programme is taught in French (English and other languages appear only as compulsory 'Anglais' transverse modules and optional UEL); the B2 French requirement supports French as the teaching language. applicationChannel intentionally omitted per the task.
